name: relaunch
description: Restart the client so a pending app-level change takes effect — today the runtime source / update channel written by setWebappUrl, which is only read at boot. Maps onto chrome::AttemptRestart(), the same call chrome://settings makes for its Relaunch button, so the open session is restored afterwards. Takes no inputs; the {ok:true} reply is dispatched before the restart task runs, but the guest is torn down immediately after and will not normally observe it.
